name: Ripio wPEN
oneLiner: WPEN is Ripio's Peruvian-sol wrapped fiat stablecoin, issued and redeemed through Ripio's wFIAT on/off-ramp infrastructure against local-currency reserves.
collateral: Each wPEN is backed 1:1 by liquid instruments denominated in Peruvian sol (PEN) held in Peruvian bank accounts, with reserves periodically attested by local public accountants per Ripio's wFIAT framework
pegMechanism: Fiat-backed 1:1 PEN stablecoin under Ripio's wFIAT framework: a Ripio subsidiary mints and burns supply via role-based access control (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE / MINTER_ROLE) against PEN collateral, with mint and redeem routed through Ripio's PEN on/off-ramp; the contract is a UUPS-upgradeable, pausable ERC-20 with EIP-2612 permit

mintAuthority.summary: WPEN is an issuer-managed Ripio wFIAT token. All chains use the same contract address with identical role holders: EOA 0x466c02e2 (DEFAULT_ADMIN + MINTER), Safe 0x2b839174 (4/7, DEFAULT_ADMIN), and two AccessControl minter-router contracts whose own admins are the same EOA and Safe.

controls.label: Ripio shared WPEN admin and MINTER_ROLE holder (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) both returned true. eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). Same role confirmed via hasRole on Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at same block range.

controls.label: Ripio WPEN Safe multisig (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) returned true. getOwners() returned 7 owners; getThreshold() returned 4. getModulesPaginated returned empty array (no modules). slot0 masterCopy = 0x41675c...61a (Safe v1.4.1 singleton). fallbackHandler = 0xfd0732...ec99 (standard CompatibilityFallbackHandler). getGuard() reverted (no guard).

controls.label: Ripio WPEN Ethereum minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WPEN token. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe). Not deployed on other chains (eth_getCode = 0x on Base).

controls.label: Ripio WPEN cross-chain minter-router contract
controls.evidence: At block 25295015, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on WPEN token on Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Contract is an AccessControl contract with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders confirmed as 0x466c02e2 (EOA) and 0x2b839174 (Safe).

review.evidence: All mint-capable role holders verified via hasRole() across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at block 25295015. EOA 0x466c02e2 confirmed via eth_getCode. Safe 0x2b839174 confirmed as 4/7 Safe v1.4.1 with no modules or guard. Minter-router contracts 0xd168cfbb and 0x46167cb0 confirmed as AccessControl contracts whose admins are the same EOA and Safe.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Ripio wPEN is centrally issued across multiple EVM chains; the public source confirms issuer-managed wFIAT mechanics but does not prove a holder-level blacklist path.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: WPEN is part of Ripio's wrapped local-stablecoin family deployed across several chains. The workflow's route signal points to Across/World-style liquidity routing rather than issuer-native bridging, so Pharos scores this as a liquidity-or-intent route with probable confidence.

reserves.name: Peruvian-sol cash and local-currency liquid instruments

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: PEN is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so WPEN is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.

notices.title: No per-token attestation located
notices.message: Ripio describes wFIAT local-currency backing, but no reliable public per-token reserve attestation was found for WPEN during this addition. Curated reserves remain conservative until source coverage improves.
